/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSchdlAtrbFromSrc */
INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ARR_DEP_SE_CD, TMNL_ID, ALN_CD, ALN_CTGRY, FLTNM, DALY_FLTSH_ID, DEP_ARR_YMD, DEP_ARR_HM, PREDC_HM, ACTL_HM, ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, ACST_NO, GATE_NO, GATE_TYPE, ARCFT_STGCP, BDPSG_CNT, TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, CRSL_NO, ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, CKNCT_RANGE_CN, SLF_CHKN_PSBLTY_YN, IRR_FLT_YN, TDFLT_YN, BUS_NEED_YN, WAYO_ID, FRST_BAG_INPUT_DT, LAST_BAG_INPUT_DT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.TMNL_ID, A.ALN_CD, A.ALN_CTGRY, A.FLTNM, A.DALY_FLTSH_ID, A.DEP_ARR_YMD, A.DEP_ARR_HM, A.PREDC_HM, A.ACTL_HM, A.ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, A.ACST_NO, A.GATE_NO, A.GATE_TYPE, A.ARCFT_STGCP, ROUND(NVL(A.BDPSG_CNT, 0) * (100 + CASE WHEN A.TMNL_ID NOT IN (#{item}) THEN 0 WHEN #{ajmtTypeCd} = 'HOURLY' THEN NVL(( SELECT T.AJMT_RT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_FLT_PSG_TMZN_AJMT T WHERE T.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND T.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.DEP_ARR_HM) >= T.BGNG_HM AND NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.DEP_ARR_HM) < NVL(T.END_HM, '2400') AND ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) ELSE #{ajmtRt} END ) / 100), A.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, A.CRSL_NO, A.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, A.CKNCT_RANGE_CN, A.SLF_CHKN_PSBLTY_YN, A.IRR_FLT_YN, A.TDFLT_YN, A.BUS_NEED_YN, A.WAYO_ID, A.FRST_BAG_INPUT_DT, A.LAST_BAG_INPUT_DT, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REPLACE(#{srcFltSchdlRsrcId}, 'FS', '')

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertCknctAtrb */
INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, BLCK_ID, TMNL_ID, CKNCT_ID, ALN_CD, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, CRTR_YMD, CHKN_OPEN_PRNMNT_DT, CHKN_CLOSE_PRNMNT_DT, CHKN_TYPE_CD, CHKN_TYPE_DTL_INFO, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, CASE WHEN #{tmnlId} = 'P03' THEN 'P03CKIN' WHEN NVL(C.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, 'I') = 'I' THEN 'P01CKINInt' ELSE 'P01CKINDom' END, #{tmnlId}, C.CKNCT_ID, B.ALN_CD, NVL(C.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, 'I'), #{excnYmd}, #{excnYmd} || LPAD(H.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, 2, '0') || '00', #{excnYmd} || LPAD(DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, 23, H.OPER_END_HOUR), 2, '0') || DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, '59', '00'), 'M', B.ALN_CD, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_BOOTH B INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_OPER_HR H ON H.SMLT_ID = B.SMLT_ID AND H.TMNL_ID = B.TMNL_ID AND H.CHKN_ISL_CD = B.CHKN_ISL_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS CHKN_ISL_CD, K.CKNCT_ID, K.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY K.CKNCT_ID) AS BOOTH_NO FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT K WHERE K.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND K.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN ('A', 'B') ) C ON C.CHKN_ISL_CD = B.CHKN_ISL_CD AND C.BOOTH_NO = B.BOOTH_NO WHERE B.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.ALN_CD IS NOT NULL

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSbdAtrb */
INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, BLCK_ID, TMNL_ID, CKNCT_ID, ALN_CD, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, CRTR_YMD, OPER_BGNG_DT, OPER_END_DT, CHKN_TYPE_CD, CHKN_TYPE_DTL_INFO, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, CASE WHEN #{tmnlId} = 'P03' THEN 'P03SBD' ELSE 'P01SBD' END, #{tmnlId}, C.CKNCT_ID, A.ALN_CD, NVL(C.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, 'I'), #{excnYmd}, #{excnYmd} || LPAD(H.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, 2, '0') || '00', #{excnYmd} || LPAD(DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, 23, H.OPER_END_HOUR), 2, '0') || DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, '59', '00'), 'C', SUBSTR(A.ALN_CD_LIST, 1, 200), #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_ISL I INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_OPER_HR H ON H.SMLT_ID = I.SMLT_ID AND H.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND H.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS CHKN_ISL_CD, K.CKNCT_ID, K.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY K.CKNCT_ID) AS DEVICE_NO FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT K WHERE K.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND K.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD = 'H' ) C ON C.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD AND C.DEVICE_NO <= NVL(I.SBD_CNT, 0) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, CHKN_ISL_CD, MIN(ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD, LISTAGG(ALN_CD, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD_LIST FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, CHKN_ISL_CD, ALN_CD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_BOOTH WHERE ALN_CD IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, CHKN_ISL_CD ) A ON A.SMLT_ID = I.SMLT_ID AND A.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND A.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD WHERE I.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND I.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId}

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSbdAtrbKiosk */
INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, BLCK_ID, TMNL_ID, CKNCT_ID, ALN_CD, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, CRTR_YMD, OPER_BGNG_DT, OPER_END_DT, CHKN_TYPE_CD, CHKN_TYPE_DTL_INFO, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, CASE WHEN #{tmnlId} = 'P03' THEN 'P03Self' ELSE 'P01Self' END, #{tmnlId}, C.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, C.ALN_CD, 'I', #{excnYmd}, #{excnYmd} || LPAD(H.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, 2, '0') || '00', #{excnYmd} || LPAD(DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, 23, H.OPER_END_HOUR), 2, '0') || DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, '59', '00'), 'C', SUBSTR(C.ALN_CD_LIST, 1, 200), #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_ISL I INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_OPER_HR H ON H.SMLT_ID = I.SMLT_ID AND H.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND H.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUBSTR(P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, 1, 1) AS CHKN_ISL_CD, P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, MIN(P.ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD, LISTAGG(P.ALN_CD, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY P.ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD_LIST, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY SUBSTR(P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID ) AS DEVICE_NO FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY P WHERE P.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND P.PLCY_YMD = ( SELECT NVL( MAX(CASE WHEN X.PLCY_YMD = #{excnYmd} THEN X.PLCY_YMD END), MAX(X.PLCY_YMD) ) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY X WHERE X.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ) GROUP BY SUBSTR(P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, 1, 1), P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID ) C ON C.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD AND C.DEVICE_NO <= NVL(I.KOS_CNT, 0) WHERE I.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND I.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId}

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertDptgtAtrb */
INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_ATRB ( DPTGT_ATRB_ID, FCLTY_OPNG_SN, TMNL_ID, FCLT_SE_CD, GATE_NO, FCLTY_CNT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.DPTGT_NO), #{tmnlId}, 'D', D.DPTGT_NO, NVL(D.GNRL_SRCH_CNTOM, 0) + NVL(D.SMART_PASS_SRCH_CNTOM, 0), #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_DPTGT D WHERE D.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND D.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND D.OPER_YN = 'Y'

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertScrtyCntrlAtrb */
INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB ( SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID, FCLTY_OPNG_SN, TMNL_ID, FCLT_SE_CD, GATE_NO, FCLTY_CNT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY X.DPTGT_NO, X.OPER_BGNG_HOUR), #{tmnlId}, 'D', X.DPTGT_NO, X.SCSH_CNTOM, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT P.DPTGT_NO, P.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, NVL(P.SCSH_CNTOM, 0) AS SCSH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCSH_OPER_PLAN P WHERE P.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND P.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} UNION ALL SELECT D.DPTGT_NO, 0 AS OPER_BGNG_HOUR, NVL(D.SCSH_CNTOM, 0) AS SCSH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_DPTGT D WHERE D.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND D.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND D.OPER_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCSH_OPER_PLAN P WHERE P.SMLT_ID = D.SMLT_ID AND P.TMNL_ID = D.TMNL_ID AND P.DPTGT_NO = D.DPTGT_NO ) ) X
